newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ dlr ends easier, seen in US$0.6970-90 range.
newsitem.headline: NZ dlr ends easier, seen in US$0.6970-90 range.

text.p: The New Zealand dollar ended easier on Wednesday in light trade, but dealers said the currency still felt comfortable around the US$0.6980 level.
The Kiwi closed at 0.6975/82, and at 66.35 on its Trade-Weighted Index, just off its opening levels of 0.6980/87 and 66.37. It traded a 0.6975-90 range during the session.
"There was a bit of selling earlier this afternoon which pushed it down to its lows," said a chief dealer.
"But it's trading up around that 0.6980 level now."
He said it had simply been a case of more sellers than buyers on a very quiet day, and there were no major issues for the Kiwi at present.
The New Zealand unit was seen coming under pressure in the lead up to the October 12 general election, but for the time being it was "comfortable" around 0.6980.
Dealers did not expect the Kiwi to retest 70 U.S. cents in the short term, and a 0.6970-90 range was picked for its overnight trade. -- Matthew Brockett (64 4) 4714 272
